# Polynx

> String-powered Polars expression engine: Pandas/SQL-style string expressions (query, eval, assign, wc, gb, case_when) with Polars speed and lazy support. Install with `pip install polynx`.

## Agent guides
- [Agent guide (AGENTS.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LowellWinston/polynx/master/src/polynx/AGENTS.md): concise API cheat sheet; also `python -m polynx` after install
- [Skill (SKILL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LowellWinston/polynx/master/skills/polynx/SKILL.md): drop-in Claude Code skill
